jobs.title: Associate AI & Automation Engineer
jobs.shortDescription: Build real-world AI applications, workflow automations, and full-stack products with LLMs, RAG, and modern web technologies. Ideal for 0–1 years experience with prior internship exposure.
jobs.description: We are looking for a passionate Associate AI & Automation Engineer who is excited about building real-world AI applications, workflow automations, and web-based products. You will work closely with the engineering team to develop AI-powered features, automate business processes, integrate LLMs, and contribute to full-stack product development. This role is ideal for candidates with prior internship experience who enjoy experimenting with AI technologies while also being comfortable building and integrating web applications. Position: Full-Time | Experience: 0–1 Years | Previous Internship Experience: Required | Mode: Remote / Hybrid | Compensation: Competitive (based on skills and experience). When applying, please share your resume, GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, portfolio/projects (if available), and a brief description of your most interesting AI or web development project.
requirements: 0–1 years of experience with at least one internship in AI, Software Development, Automation, Full Stack Development, or a related field
Basic understanding of Machine Learning and Generative AI concepts
Experience integrating APIs and automation workflows
Familiarity with Large Language Models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.)
Understanding of Prompt Engineering concepts
Knowledge of AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar
Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) fundamentals
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with ability to learn new technologies quickly
Good communication, collaboration skills, and a self-driven mindset
Nice to have: Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma)
Nice to have: Experience with FastAPI, Express.js, React.js, Next.js, AWS/GCP/Azure, Docker, or GitHub Actions
Nice to have: Experience building AI agents, multi-agent systems, or contributions to open-source projects
Bonus: Prior work on AI Agents, Workflow Automation Systems, Full-Stack Web Applications, or Internal Productivity Tools
responsibilities: Build and maintain AI-powered applications using modern LLMs and AI frameworks
Develop workflow automations using APIs, AI agents, and no-code/low-code automation platforms
Create AI-driven features such as chatbots, document processing systems, search systems, and intelligent assistants
Work with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and vector databases
Integrate third-party APIs and AI services into web applications
Develop and maintain frontend and backend components of web applications
Assist in prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI experimentation
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to prototype and ship new features quickly
Research emerging AI tools, frameworks, and automation technologies
benefits: Full-time role with competitive compensation based on skills and experience
Hands-on work on AI agents, automation systems, and full-stack products
Exposure to modern LLMs, RAG, and agent frameworks
Collaboration with product and engineering teams on fast-paced feature delivery
Opportunity to grow into advanced AI and platform engineering responsibilities
selectionProcess: Application review (resume, GitHub, LinkedIn, and portfolio)
Technical assignment focused on AI, automation, or full-stack skills

jobs.title: AI & Full Stack Intern
jobs.shortDescription: Learn and build real-world AI and full-stack applications alongside experienced engineers. Ideal for students or recent graduates curious about AI, automation, and modern web development.
jobs.description: We are looking for an enthusiastic AI & Full Stack Intern who is eager to learn and build real-world applications. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates who have basic knowledge of web development and are interested in exploring AI, automation, and modern software development. You will work alongside experienced engineers to build features, experiment with AI tools, integrate APIs, and contribute to both frontend and backend development. Duration: 3–6 Months | Mode: Remote / Hybrid | Stipend: Based on skills and project experience | Opportunity for a full-time role based on performance. When applying, please share your resume, GitHub profile (if available), LinkedIn profile (if available), portfolio/projects (if available), and a brief description of a project you have built or contributed to. We value curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn over extensive experience.
requirements: Basic understanding of JavaScript
Familiarity with React.js or Next.js
Basic understanding of APIs and web applications
Familiarity with Git and GitHub
Interest in AI, automation, and modern software development
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn
Ability to work independently and communicate effectively
Nice to have: Basic knowledge of Node.js or Python
Nice to have: Exposure to AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude
Nice to have: Familiarity with MongoDB or PostgreSQL
Nice to have: Basic understanding of prompt engineering, React Native, Docker, or cloud platforms
Preferred projects: AI Chatbots, Personal AI Projects, Full-Stack Web Apps, Mobile Apps, Automation Tools, College or Hackathon Projects
responsibilities: Assist in building AI-powered features and applications
Work on simple workflow automations and API integrations
Develop and maintain frontend components using modern web technologies
Support backend development and API implementation
Help integrate AI services such as OpenAI, Gemini, or similar platforms
Participate in debugging, testing, and improving application performance
Collaborate with team members to build and ship product features
Research and learn new technologies related to AI and software development
benefits: 3–6 month internship with stipend based on skills and project experience
Hands-on experience with AI tools and full-stack development
Opportunity for a full-time role based on performance
Strong focus on learning, building, and shipping real product features
selectionProcess: Application review (resume, GitHub, LinkedIn, and project description)
